message: I still remember the time my phone decided to play dead right before a big storm hit. I had all these apps lined up for updates, but there I was, staring at a black screen while the wind howled outside. It was a reminder that sometimes, relying on tech alone can let us down. Now, I keep a simple battery-powered weather radio handy, just in case. It’s a little old-school, but it gives me peace of mind when the skies turn gray. Anyone else have a tech fail during a storm?
